hook: orphan 移動團擠轉運站：traipse／meander／scamper／lumber——廣播「別用爬的速度趕車」。
script: traipse 疲憊走。meander 曲折繞。scamper 蹦跳。lumber 笨重走。saunter 溜達。trudge 跋涉。口令：轉運站寫「選對步態」，趕車寫「別 meander」。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 拖步: traipse walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「拖步」出場：traipse 一上場梗就黏住——疲憊行走。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 小跑: scamper walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「小跑」出場：scamper 一上場梗就黏住——蹦跳跑。

members.senseAnchor: the wood of trees cut and prepared for use as building material; an implement used in baseball by the batter
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 笨重步: lumber walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「笨重步」出場：lumber 一上場梗就黏住——笨重走。

members.senseAnchor: a careless leisurely gait; a leisurely walk (usually in some public place)
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 溜達: saunter walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「溜達」出場：saunter 一上場梗就黏住——閒逛。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 沉重步: trudge walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「沉重步」出場：trudge 一上場梗就黏住——跋涉。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 慢步: amble walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「慢步」出場：amble 一上場梗就黏住——緩行。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 大步: stride walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「大步」出場：stride 一上場梗就黏住——大步走。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 鬼祟走: skulk walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「鬼祟走」出場：skulk 一上場梗就黏住——潛行。

members.senseAnchor: the act of prowling (walking about in a stealthy manner); move about in or as if in a predatory manner
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 巡游: prowl walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「巡游」出場：prowl 一上場梗就黏住——徘徊覓食。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 轉運站: station walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「轉運站」出場：station 一上場梗就黏住——轉運站。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 長椅: bench walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「長椅」出場：bench 一上場梗就黏住——長椅。
